concept: Maintaining a hard habit (health, finances, skill) long after the initial motivation has faded
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic scenario where an adult's initial enthusiasm for a health, financial, or skill-building habit has faded months in
exercise.reflection_prompt: What actually sustains a habit once motivation runs out?
exercise.practice: Adult identifies one habit they've let slide and one concrete system (not just willpower) to support it

assessment.success_marker: adult proposes a specific system or structure, not just a renewed intention to 'try harder'
